raceIntelligence.headline: Austin Title Watch — Antonelli Can Clinch as Verstappen Builds Momentum
raceIntelligence.summary: Antonelli heads to the United States Grand Prix on Oct 23–25 leading Russell 340–238. One title-clinching scenario requires an Antonelli win, Russell P9 or lower and Hamilton P5 or lower. Verstappen arrives after consecutive Grand Prix wins; McLaren leads Red Bull by seven constructors’ points.
raceIntelligence.updatedLabel: Updated Oct 14, 2026 · United States Grand Prix outlook

watchPoints.label: WATCH POINT 01
watchPoints.title: Antonelli can clinch in Austin
watchPoints.summary: Antonelli leads Russell by 102. A win in Austin seals the title if Russell is P9 or lower and Hamilton P5 or lower; Antonelli needs a lead of at least 125 after the race.

watchPoints.label: WATCH POINT 02
watchPoints.title: Verstappen and Red Bull carry momentum to Austin
watchPoints.summary: Verstappen has won the last two Grands Prix at Sepang and Singapore. Tom Hart is set to engineer Verstappen at Austin as Red Bull begins its race-engineer transition.

watchPoints.label: WATCH POINT 03
watchPoints.title: Red Bull closes on McLaren
watchPoints.summary: McLaren 339, Red Bull 332 — seven points separate third and fourth.

watchPoints.label: WATCH POINT 04
watchPoints.title: Mercedes Confirms Faster Upgrade as Russell Considers Las Vegas Engine Penalty
watchPoints.summary: Mercedes says Antonelli’s upgraded W17 was faster by the end of Singapore. Russell identifies Las Vegas as a possible venue for another engine penalty.

watchPoints.label: LAST RACE
watchPoints.title: Verstappen completes Singapore double
watchPoints.summary: Verstappen wins the Grand Prix ahead of Leclerc and Antonelli after Saturday’s Sprint victory.

articles.title: Austin Circuit Intelligence: COTA’s 2026 F1 Title Test
articles.summary: COTA’s 56-lap title test: the official Austin schedule, the 102-point Antonelli lead, Verstappen’s form and the seven-point McLaren–Red Bull fight.

articles.title: Haas Confirms Rafael Câmara for 2027 as Ocon Seat Vacancy Closes
articles.summary: Haas confirms 21-year-old Rafael Câmara on a multi-year deal for 2027. The F2 leader fills the seat opened by Esteban Ocon’s planned departure.

articles.title: Verstappen’s Portimão GT3 Debut: Grid, Schedule and Why It Matters Before Austin
articles.summary: Verstappen is entered for Saturday’s three-hour GT World Challenge Europe finale with Lulham and Barnicoat in the #3 Mercedes-AMG GT3 EVO. Verified race guide ahead of Austin.

articles.title: Formula 1 Confirms 10-Year Rwanda Grand Prix Deal for Early 2030s
articles.summary: Formula 1 confirms a 10-year African Grand Prix agreement with Rwanda. A new FIA Grade 1 circuit in Bugesera is planned; the first race date is not yet fixed.

articles.title: Red Bull Extends Laurent Mekies Through 2031 as Verstappen Revival Gathers Pace
articles.summary: Red Bull confirms Laurent Mekies will remain CEO and Team Principal through 2031, securing leadership continuity after Verstappen’s consecutive victories.

articles.title: Verstappen to Work With Tom Hart in Austin as Red Bull Begins Race-Engineer Handover
articles.summary: Hart is set to engineer Verstappen at Austin as Red Bull begins its Lambiase transition after two straight Grand Prix victories.

articles.title: McLaren Says 2026 Handling Problem Needs a 2027 Fix — Austin Upgrades Have Limits
articles.summary: Stella says McLaren’s 2026 aero upgrades will not cure its underlying handling issue; Red Bull trails by seven constructors’ points.

articles.title: How Antonelli Can Win the 2026 F1 Championship in Austin
articles.summary: Antonelli leads Russell by 102 points. Explore the precise Austin title scenarios and the remaining championship mathematics.

articles.title: Verstappen Wins Singapore Grand Prix as Antonelli Extends Title Lead to 102 Points
articles.summary: Verstappen completes a Singapore Sprint-and-Grand-Prix double, winning ahead of Leclerc and Antonelli. The championship leader moves 102 points clear of Russell; Red Bull trails McLaren by seven.

articles.title: Verstappen Takes 50th Career Pole in Singapore as Ferrari Locks Out P2 and P3
articles.summary: Verstappen took his 50th pole. Russell qualified sixth but started P19 after a cumulative 60-place power-unit penalty; the Grand Prix was subsequently won by Verstappen.

articles.title: Verstappen Wins Chaotic Singapore Sprint as Russell Crashes — Antonelli Leads by 89
articles.summary: Verstappen wins the rain-hit Singapore Sprint ahead of Hamilton and Leclerc. Russell crashes while leading, McLarens collide, and Antonelli extends his championship lead to 89 points.

articles.title: Verstappen Retains Singapore Sprint Pole After Stewards Decline Penalty
articles.summary: Verstappen retains Sprint pole after the stewards ruling; a separate FIA SQ1 Overtake Mode error affected some drivers.

articles.title: Mercedes Confirms Faster Upgrade as Russell Considers Las Vegas Engine Penalty
articles.summary: Mercedes says Antonelli’s upgraded W17 was faster by the end of Singapore. Russell identifies Las Vegas as a possible venue for another engine penalty.

articles.title: Antonelli Takes an 84-Point Lead Into Marina Bay
articles.summary: Singapore's Sprint format gives the field only one practice session before competitive running, with Antonelli 84 points clear of Russell.

articles.title: Verstappen Wins Rain-Hit Sepang Race as Antonelli Extends Championship Lead
articles.summary: Verstappen delivered Red Bull's first 2026 Grand Prix win, Antonelli finished second, Hamilton third and Russell retired late.

articles.title: Verstappen Takes Sepang Pole as Hamilton Sets Up Sunday Showdown
articles.summary: Verstappen took his first pole of 2026 ahead of Hamilton, with penalties reshaping the grid behind them.

articles.title: Sepang Circuit Intelligence: Tyres, Strategy and Weather
articles.summary: Pirelli's C2/C3/C4 allocation, abrasive asphalt, tropical heat and rain risk framed Formula 1's return to Sepang.
